scope: Read-only cumulative architectural review of Wave C deliverables (Payment Plan B + NF525 post Refund+Z+PDF cycles + frozen-zone discipline + test helpers + wizard 5-templates).
verdict_rationale: Wave C is architecturally sound on 4 of 5 audits (A1 Plan B layer discipline GREEN with one pattern divergence flagged YELLOW; A2 NF525 chain GREEN proven; A3 frozen-zone diff GREEN proven by git; A5 wizard parity GREEN per recent audit). Audit A4 (test helpers) is RED-MISSING-ARTIFACT: the 4 named helpers (admin-auth.js / idempotency-key.js / kiosk-auth.js / place-order.js) DO NOT EXIST anywhere in the repo. Z2-NF525 / Z3-WIZARD / Z4-LATENCY subdirs are empty (only Z1 produced output). REVISE means the architecture work is acceptable but two corrections are required before shipping: (a) Z1 pattern divergence (nested kiosk.* vs flat kiosk*) decision must be ratified by owner because sentinel test pins the nested form; (b) supervisor must either confirm test helpers were renamed/relocated or accept their absence as out-of-scope.

A1_payment_plan_b.layer_discipline: Compliant. Config (config/kiosk.php:34-54 + dual-return at lines 146-147 single-path 232 — see git diff) injects flag once; Blade (resources/views/master.blade.php:149-155) exposes to window.foodkingConfig; Vue computed (KioskPaymentComponent.vue:333-339) reads + guards UI; Backend untouched (FrontendOrderService.php:206-208 + 266 already supports is_counter_deferred_kiosk_cash → PENDING_COUNTER routing). Each layer has a single explicit responsibility, no short-circuit, no double-write.
A1_payment_plan_b.pattern_cohesion: Mostly compliant. Config-flag pattern mirrors locale_switch_allowed (config/kiosk.php:31 + master.blade.php:147) — same env + filter_var + dual-return discipline. PROBLEM: Z1 architecture recommended the FLAT key kioskPaymentRouteAllToCounter on window.foodkingConfig (mirroring the 14 existing kiosk* keys: kioskAutoLogin, kioskDefaultLocale, kioskLocaleSwitchAllowed, kioskMenuPricing, kioskSandwichSplit, kioskConfirmationAutoReturnSeconds, etc. all flat at master.blade.php:140-159). The implementer chose a NESTED object: kiosk: { paymentRouteAllToCounter } (master.blade.php:153-155). Both forms are technically equivalent but introduce a new naming convention. The sentinel spec tests/js/kioskPaymentPlanBRoute.spec.js:41,49 PINS the nested form — flipping to flat would break the sentinel. Either (a) ratify nested as the new convention going forward and migrate existing 14 keys over time, OR (b) flatten now (8-line diff) before the convention scatters. The DRIFT cost is low TODAY, compounding TOMORROW.
A1_payment_plan_b.ddd_boundary_preservation: Compliant. Plan B is purely a frontend UI gate; pricing SSOT (PricingService — §7 frozen — untouched), payment state machine (FrontendOrderService:206-208,266 PaymentStatus::PENDING_COUNTER mapping pre-existing), fiscal sequence allocation (FiscalSequenceService — §7 frozen — untouched), audit chain (AuditLogService — §7 frozen — untouched). No new business invariant introduced. The flag is forward-compatible with Plan A (single env flip).
A1_payment_plan_b.backward_compatibility: Compliant. Existing 22 orders in production (per mission preamble — current fresh DB shows 0 orders post migrate:fresh, normal baseline reset 2026-05-28) follow the SAME backend path. Setting KIOSK_PAYMENT_ROUTE_ALL_TO_COUNTER=false in env restores legacy 3-method UI without code change.
evidence: config/kiosk.php:34-54 (flag declaration with full comment block)

git diff shows config/kiosk.php second return-path (line 207-236) MISSING the new key — Z1 said add to BOTH return arrays but the auto-login branch return at line 207 does NOT include payment_route_all_to_counter. POTENTIAL BUG: if APP_ENV != local AND spa_payload truthy, the second return executes and the flag silently defaults to TRUE via config('kiosk.payment_route_all_to_counter', true) — defensive default saves it BUT the architecture's dual-return-path discipline is BROKEN. RECOMMEND: add the key to the second return array (line ~231) to honour Z1 patternevidence.
resources/views/master.blade.php:149-155 (nested kiosk.* object — divergent from 14 prior flat keys at lines 140-159)

resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskPaymentComponent.vue:417-428 (confirmCounterRoute method — forces method='cash' then delegates to confirmPayment → processCashPayment → kiosk.cash-instruction navigation, reusing existing pipeline)

resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskPaymentComponent.vue:53,71,81,93,196,247 (six v-if !paymentRouteAllToCounter guards correctly hide CB/TR tiles, network-offline banner, confirm button, TPE waiting overlay — also hides network-offline alert which is correct since cash flow is independent of TPE network)
app/Services/FrontendOrderService.php:206-208 (is_counter_deferred_kiosk_cash gate already maps CASH_ON_DELIVERY + kiosk → PENDING_COUNTER)
recommendations: P1 — Fix missing flag in auto-login branch return at config/kiosk.php ~line 231 (dual-return-path discipline). Tests will still pass via defensive config() default, but ops cannot toggle the flag in production where APP_ENV != local + spa_payload is set.

P1 — Decide nested-vs-flat convention. If nested wins: document in CLAUDE.md §11 + ADR, plan migration of existing 14 flat keys to a kiosk.* namespace via 2-step compat shim. If flat wins: ship 8-line refactor to flatten + update sentinel before drift compounds.

A4_test_helpers.search_result: find . -type f -name '<helper>' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/vendor/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' returned ZERO matches for ALL FOUR named helpers across the entire repository.
A4_test_helpers.interpretation: Three plausible scenarios: (a) The named helpers were a PROPOSED Wave C deliverable that never landed because Z2/Z3/Z4 produced no output (their subdirs are empty — only Z1 wrote architecture.json). (b) The helpers exist under a different name in tests/Support or tests/Playwright (worth a manual grep of utility imports). (c) The supervisor brief is forward-looking and the helpers will land in a follow-on commit. CURRENT EVIDENCE FAVOURS (a) — Z agents 2/3/4 did not produce output.
A4_test_helpers.reusability_assessment: Cannot be performed — artefacts absent. No file:line evidence to cite.
A4_test_helpers.recommendation: P0 supervisor decision required: (a) Confirm helpers are out-of-scope for Wave C and move audit to BACKLOG, OR (b) Re-dispatch Z2/Z3/Z4 implement sub-agents with explicit instruction to land the helpers + sentinel + smoke before XCUT closes. Without the helpers, the test-pyramid stays at sentinel-only level — Plan B has tests/js/kioskPaymentPlanBRoute.spec.js as a STATIC SOURCE-CODE GREP sentinel only, no functional Playwright E2E that drives the kiosk happy-path with Plan B active end-to-end through to PENDING_COUNTER + POS counter-collect + Z append. That coverage gap is the implicit value the named helpers were meant to deliver.

verdict_rationale_final: 4 of 5 audits GREEN. 1 audit RED for missing artefacts (test helpers) + 1 architectural pattern divergence + 1 dual-return-path bug detected during A1 review. NONE are NF525 / fiscal / frozen-zone violations. NONE block deploy of Plan B itself. ALL block 'XCUT GREEN' supervisor sign-off until: (1) supervisor ratifies or fixes the dual-return-path miss in config/kiosk.php auto-login branch return, (2) supervisor decides nested-vs-flat config-key convention and aligns sentinel + 14 prior keys accordingly, (3) supervisor confirms whether the 4 named test helpers are scope or backlog. If owner declares (3) backlog and (1)+(2) are fixed inline, XCUT goes ARCHITECTURE_GREEN.

blockers_for_architecture_green.description: config/kiosk.php auto-login branch return (lines 207-236) is MISSING the payment_route_all_to_counter key. Only the requireForm branch return (lines 119-152) has it. Dual-return-path discipline broken.
blockers_for_architecture_green.impact_if_left: In production (APP_ENV != local + spa_payload truthy), config() defensive default of true saves the day. Ops CANNOT flip the flag at runtime via env without the key being present in the returned array — the env var becomes a no-op until config:clear AND code path adjustment.

blockers_for_architecture_green.description: Nested kiosk: { paymentRouteAllToCounter } divergence from 14 prior flat kiosk* keys on window.foodkingConfig. Sentinel test pins the nested form so flipping has 2-spec cost.
blockers_for_architecture_green.fix: Owner decision: nested or flat? If nested → document in CLAUDE.md §4 + plan 14-key migration. If flat → flatten to kioskPaymentRouteAllToCounter + update sentinel (8 LOC total).
blockers_for_architecture_green.impact_if_left: Drift convention compounds across future config additions. Cost grows over time.

blockers_for_architecture_green.fix: Either spawn Z2/Z3/Z4 implement agents OR confirm scope reduction.
blockers_for_architecture_green.impact_if_left: Plan B has source-code grep sentinel only — no functional E2E coverage of the new path through to PENDING_COUNTER + counter-collect + Z.

non_blockers_yellow_notes.description: z_reports.signature populated as expected, but schema column is named signature not chain_hash. Documentation in CLAUDE.md §8 says 'HMAC chain-signed' — accurate but the column name discrepancy is worth a doc cross-link to avoid future confusion.

Plan B short-circuits payment UI but Confirm button on counter-route screen still runs full confirmPayment pipeline which depends on _kioskSpeech + reconcilePendingPayments timer. Both have try/catch but are dead-effort under Plan B. Code is correct, just carries non-essential cost. Acceptable for V1.

rollback_plan: Single env flip: KIOSK_PAYMENT_ROUTE_ALL_TO_COUNTER=false + php artisan config:clear. Restores legacy 3-method UI in <30s. ZERO code rollback needed.
